description: Optional caller/gateway-supplied correlation id. A webhook-triggered run carries body.traceId; the monitor CAPTURES-AND-ECHOES it (never generated) onto runtime.traceId and into both the redacted audit event and the run-output record. It feeds NO id/hash/digest seed and is kept OUT of the digest prose (digest-integrity safe). traceId falls back to requestId when absent, and is null on a bare schedule run. Additive: every other field stays byte-identical to the same run without a traceId.
